name: assassin
description: an Assassin (Fall from Heaven), a lean hooded killer in a low crouched stance: a deep charcoal-grey hood, a black cloth mask over the nose and mouth leaving only a strip of tan skin and dark eyes showing, dark blue-grey leather armour with steel-grey shoulder plates, brown leather straps across the chest, brown leather bracers and gloves, a red sash at the waist with long red ends hanging down the front, dark grey trousers with brown knee bands, black boots, and a short steel dagger in EACH hand: the one in his LEFT hand angled down to the right, the one in his RIGHT hand angled down to the left
hands: the striking dagger stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the second dagger stays in his right hand on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the left hand lifts its dagger up over the head with the blade pointing up and back, the right hand's dagger held low
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the left hand's dagger cocked behind the head with the blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the right hand's dagger tucked in at the hip
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the left arm sweeps over the head and the dagger blade is level, pointing to the lower-right, the right hand's dagger held low
strike.4: contact: dagger arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the left hand's dagger stabbing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the right arm swung back for balance with its second dagger
strike.5: follow-through: the dagger arm carries on down until the blade points at the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the hood and the red sash ends trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the left hand's dagger comes back toward the ready angle, the right hand's dagger held low

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right hand's dagger flung out to the left, the left dagger arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the left hand's dagger dipping, the right hand's dagger still held out
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the crouched ready pose, a dagger in each hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the left dagger arm flung up, the right hand's dagger drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the left hand's dagger lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the left hand's dagger point resting on the ground, the right arm hanging with its dagger
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, both daggers slip out of his hands, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the hood still over his head; the two daggers lie on the ground at the lower-right; the red sash ends spread on the ground
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hood and the red sash settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed above the black mask, the two daggers on the ground beside him
